description: A Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) for addressing security deficiencies is not developed or maintained. This signal indicates that identified security gaps may not be tracked to resolution.
applicability: Applicable to all identified security deficiencies. Includes vulnerability findings, assessment gaps, audit findings, and other security weaknesses requiring remediation.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through POA&M documentation review, remediation tracking verification, and milestone progress assessment.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
